source: Walking through the city, Sam couldn’t help but feel the nervous energy permeating the entire area.
target: Ambulans per urbem, Sam non potuit non sentire vim anxiam, quae totam regionem pervadebat.

source: People were walking faster, almost hunching in on themselves, looking around nervously or even fearfully, and the mana in the air was infested with a very thin layer of cloying miasma that was like sweat on a humid summer day.
target: Homines celerius ambulabant, paene se incurvantes, circumiacentes trepide aut etiam timide, et mana in aere infestata erat tenuissima pellicula miasmatis, sicut sudor in die aestivo umido.

source: It was sticky and clung to the body no matter what one did.
target: Erat viscosum et ad corpus haerebat, quocumque modo ageretur.

source: Thankfully, Sam always had his Mana Shield up, so when the very familiar miasma tried to stick to his skin, it just slid off uselessly.
target: Gratias Deo, Sam semper scutum Manæ tenebat, ita ut cum miasma notissimum ad cutem eius haerere conaretur, inutilem lapsum passum est.

source: Sam scowled and began to hasten his steps towards the old man’s house to finish the quest.
target: Sam vultum contraxit et pedes celeriter ad domum senis properare coepit ut quaestionem perficiat.

source: If the origin of the miasma was related to the people who planned the Monster Break for the city of Ironwood and managed to infest Lady Silvercrest with that parasite, then the destruction of one of their bases would more than likely change their timetables.
target: Si origo miasmatis attinet ad illos qui "Monster Break" pro urbe Ironwood consilium ceperunt et dominam Silvercrest parasitum infesterunt, tunc destructio unius eorum basis verisimiliter eorum tempora mutabit.

source: And because Sam only had the basics of the idea about what they were planning, he didn’t like that.
target: Et quia Sam solum fundamenta ideae de eorum consilio habebat, id non ei placuit.

source: Navigating the shadowed streets of the bad part of the town, he soon arrived back before the old ranger’s house.
target: Per umbratiles vias parte infausta oppidi navigans, mox ad domum veteris silvatici rediit.

source: When he looked around, he thought he saw the flash of somebody with a very small body watching the house, but when he went to take another look, the alley was empty.
target: Cum circumspiciebat, putavit se fulgor aliqui parvuli corporis, qui domum intuēbatur, vidisse; sed cum iterum intuērī conatus est, vicula vacuum apparuit.

source: Shaking his head, he stepped up to the door and knocked.
target: Capite concussus, ad ianuam accessit et pulsavit.

source: Compared to the first time he visited the old man, this time he didn’t have to wait even a few seconds.
target: Comparato primo tempore senem visitando, hoc tempore ne pauca quidem secunda exspectare non debuit.

source: The door was almost wrenched open and old man Marak was standing there with tousled hair and mustache, holding an enchanted watering can.
target: Iana paene abrupte aperta erat et senex Marak ibi stabat, capillis discorsisque et barbata, canistrum incantatum tenens.

source: “Who… Oh, it’s you!” the old man yelled, then grumbled as he recognized Sam.
target: "Quis... O, tu es!" exclamavit senex, deinde murmuravit cum Sam agnovit.

source: “Did you fail?”
target: "Defecisti?"

source: “No, Sir. Item retrieved, monster pacified and…” he didn’t manage to finish his report as the older man grabbed him by the hem of his cloak and pulled him into the house, the door closing behind him automatically.
target: "Non, domine. Res recuperata, monstrum sedatum et..." non potuit relationem suam perficere, cum senex eum a margine pallii arripuit et in domum traxit, ianuam post eum automatice claudens.

source: “Even the walls have ears, you moron…” grumbled the ranger, then placed the watering can next to the door rather aggressively and motioned to Sam to follow him.
target: "Etiam muri aures habent, stulte..." murmurat custos silvestris, deinde canistrum incantatum iuxta ianuam commode posuit et Sam monuit ut eum sequeretur.

source: They returned to the same room where Sam received his quest, took seats in the same chairs, and Sam watched through his senses as the old man performed the same procedure to ascertain if somebody was listening on them (though, it was more forceful than last time).
target: Redierunt in eandem conclave, ubi Sam propositum suum accepit, sedes in eadem subselliis ceperunt, et Sam per sensus intuens vidit senem eandem rationem gerere ad comprobandum si quis eos auscultaret (quamquam cum maiore vi quam prius).

source: Sam spent a moment getting comfortable, while Lucky just left his shadow with a little hop and skip and settled before the roaring fireplace and closed his eyes.
target: Sam momentum consumpsit se commodi restituens, dum Lucky umbram suam parvo saltu relinquens ante focum rugientem consedit et oculos clausit.

source: He chuckled at his companion, then turned towards his quest giver.
target: Sam subridens comiti suo, deinde ad eum qui propositum dedit se convertit.

source: “Is it safe?”
target: "Estne tutum?"

source: “As much as it can be in these times…” came the grumble from the old man. “There is just something in the air…”
target: "Quantum potest in his temporibus esse..." inquit senex murmurans. "Aliquid tamen in aere est..."

source: “Miasma.”
target: "Miasma."

source: “What?”
target: "Quid?"

source: “Miasma is in the air.”
target: "Miasma in aere est."

source: The old man closed his eyes, took a deep breath and Sam watched through his other senses as the mana in the air entered the man’s lung and as he exhaled, left it.
target: Senex oculos clausit, spiritum altum attulit, et Sam per reliquos sensus intuens vidit mana in aere pulmonem senis ingredi et, dum exhalaret, eam relinquere.

source: “Miasma.”
target: "Miasma."

source: “Yes.”
target: "Ita."

source: “By the gods…” The older man shook his head, and then returned his attention to Sam. “Start at the beginning!”
target: "Per deos..." Senex caput concussit et ad Sam evolvit. "Ab initio incipias!"

source: “All right, Sir!” replied Sam while settling back in the chair and began to tell Marak about his journey. “I found the first symbol where you told me and then…”
target: "Recte, domine!" respondit Sam, repositus in subsellio, et coepit narratio eius Marak de itinere suo. "Primum symbolum inveni, ubi me indicavisti, et deinde…"

source: “…and that’s about what I know.”
target: "…et hoc fere est quod scio."

source: Sam finished his explanation, followed by watching the older man as the room fell silent. The only sound that could be heard was the roaring of the fire and Lucky’s gentle breathing.
target: Sam narrationem finivit, et secus senem spectavit dum conclave silentiaque replebatur. Solus sonus auditus erat: ignis rugiens et leni respiratio Lucky.

source: For a long minute, the old man just sat there with his eyes closed, contemplating everything that Sam told him. The forest, the giant cricket monster, the ruin, the miasma and the fights.
target: Per longum momentum, senex ibi sedebat, oculis clausis, omnia quae Sam narraverat meditans: silva, ingens monstrum gryllorum, ruina, miasma, et pugnae.

source: “I see,” spoke the old man up finally, then he opened his eyes and looked at Sam. And as Sam looked back, he couldn’t help but shudder at the look in the old man’s eyes. It radiated anger, sadness, guilt and was tinged with slight greenish light that reminded Sam of a forest after a fresh rain.
target: "Intelligo," inquit senex demum, deinde oculos aperuit et Sam inspicuit. Et cum Sam intuēbatur, non potuit non tremere aspectu oculorum senis, qui iram, tristitiam et culpam efferebant, et leviter viridi lumine tincti erant, qui Sam silvam post recentem pluviam commemorabant.

source: “Thank you, young man. You did me, the woods and the city, a great favor,” continued the old man.
target: "Gratias tibi, iuvenis. Nobis beneficium fecisti."

source: “But now I must ask you to leave. I have certain matters to attend to…”
target: "Sed nunc te rogare habeo ut discedas. Negotia quaedam mihi attendenda sunt…"

source: “You’re going to visit that cricket?”
target: "Illud creticum visitabis?"

source: “Indeed,” the older man answered with a nod. “It is rather dishonorable that we had forgotten one of the protectors of the forest, even if they were asleep. So, I must rectify this.”
target: "Certe," respondit senex, annuendo. "Non honeste est quod unum ex defensoribus silvae oblivissemus, etiam si dormiret; itaque hoc corrigere debeo."

source: Sam nodded in understanding and noting the unspoken dismissal, stood up.
target: Sam intellexit et, tacita expromissione notata, surrexit.

source: Lucky, noticing his movement, also woke up, stretched, and then without a sound, jumped back into his shadow.
target: Lucky, motum eius animadvertens, evigilavit quoque, se extendit, et sine sono in umbram suam saliit.

source: “Then I will take my leave. After all, I have to deliver the Chalice to the Silvercrest family.”
target: "Tum discedam. Omnino, calicem ad familiam Silvercrest tradere mihi oportet."

source: The older man nodded, and for a moment, the multitude of feelings in his eyes was replaced with humor.
target: Senex annuit, et per breve momentum, multitudinem sensuum in oculis eius risu commutavit.

source: “Good luck!” He snickered a little, then while Sam was making sure he had everything with him, he stepped up to one of the shelves and retrieved a rather thick tome.
target: "Bona fortuna!" inquit leviter subridens, deinde dum Sam omnia secum habere curabat, ad unum ex armariis accessit et volumine crasso rapuit.

source: The old man stepped up to Sam, who was watching him interestedly, while inwardly salivating at the thought of what kind of reward he would get.
target: Senex ad Sam accessit, qui eum studiosus intuens erat, interius salivans ad cogitationem praemii quod acciperet.

source: “I noticed during your story that you had some glaring holes in your repertoire, so here, young man. Take it with my thanks!”
target: "Animadverti in tua narratione te hiatus conspicuos in tuo repertorio habere; ideo, iuvenis, accipe hoc cum mea gratitudine!"

source: Sam took the big book and as he held it in his hand he noticed that it was surprisingly light despite its look.
target: Sam magnum librum tulit et, dum in manu tenebat, animadvertit eum prorsus levem esse, non obstante aspectu crasso.

source: “Thank you, sir.”
target: "Gratias tibi ago, domine."

source: Then, without waiting for the old man to say anything else, he turned around and left the house leaving an old man with a renewed purpose behind.
target: Tum, sine senex ulteriorem rem dicere exspectans, se vertit et domum reliquit, senem proposito renovato post se relinquens.

source: The moment he left the last step leading to the old ranger’s home, a notification screen popped up on his screen.
target: Statim, postquam ultimum gradum ad domum veteris silvatici reliquit, schermo nuntiationis subito apparuit.

source: [The quest ‘To peek or not to peek?’ has been completed!]
target: [Quaestus "Speculare an non speculare?" perfectus est!]

source: [You received the ‘Grimoire of Sharp Winds’ as a reward!]
target: [Praemium accepisti: "Grimoire Ventorum Acuorum" !]

source: Sam inhaled as he read the screen, then had to fight not to break out in joyous laughter.
target: Sam inspiravit dum tabulam legebat, et deinde pugnare debuit ne in gaudium risum effunderet.

source: He didn’t receive a spellbook or skill book.
target: Non accepit librum incantationum aut librum artium.

source: He received a Grimoire!
target: Grimoriem accepit!

source: While spell books, scrolls or skill books only contained one spell or skill, a Grimoire, depending on their rarity and origin, could contain anything from one to several dozen spells or skills.
target: Dum libri incantationum, volumina, aut libri artium solum unam incantationem aut artem continebant, Grimoire, secundum raritatem et originem, possit continere ab una usque ad plura duodecim incantationes aut artes.

source: Greater Grimoires sometimes even contained entire branches of magic.
target: Grimoria maiora interdum totos ramos magiae complectebantur.

source: His original reward would have been probably one or two skills or spells, depending on how he did on the quest, but because he managed to finish it the way he did, it was upgraded.
target: Praemium eius originaliter probabiliter unum aut duo incantationes aut artes esse debuit, prout in quaestione se gesserit; sed quia eam perficere potuit, elevatum est.

source: Sam couldn’t wait to open the Grimoire and learn the spells in them.
target: Sam non potuit exspectare ut Grimoriem aperiret et incantationes in ea disceret.

source: Carefully putting away the tome, he pulled his hood up and began walking slowly towards the Cloudy Inn.
target: Diligenter volumine reponens, pallium capitis cepit et lente ad Cloudy Inn ambulare coepit.

source: He needed a proper rest.
target: Ei opus erat requies digna.

source: But as he walked by an unassuming alley, he heard a noise.
target: Sed dum per viculam modicam ambulabat, sonum audivit.

source: “Psst!”
target: "Psst!"

source: Sam closed his eyes, took a deep breath, and turned towards the alley with a forced smile.
target: Sam oculos clausit, spiravit alte, et forzato risu ad viculam se convertit.

source: “Yes?”
target: "Ita?"

source: He wasn’t disappointed, as covered by the shadows was a very familiar street urchin, looking up at him with a mischievous look on their face.
target: Non fuit deiectus, quoniam in umbris apparuerit notus puer vagus, qui eum intuens vultu ludico aspiciebat.

source: “Congratulations!”
target: "Felicitations!"

source: Sam said nothing, just stared at the being masquerading as a boy (or girl, it was really hard to determine).
target: Sam nihil dixit, solum intuens illud ens se puerum (vel puellam, difficile discerni) fingentem.

source: The urchin stared at him for a moment, then scowled and spat at the ground.
target: Puer vagus illum per momentum intuens, deinde vultum contraxit et in terram sputavit.

source: “Ugh, so not fair if you know about it.”
target: "Heu, tam iniustum, si scias."

source: Sam raised an eyebrow, inwardly enjoying the frustration he was causing.
target: Sam supercilium levavit, interiora fruens frustratione quam effecit.

source: “Do you want anything?”
target: "Visne aliquid?"

source: The Fey sighed and nodded.
target: Fey suspiravit et annuit.

source: They reached inside their ratty clothing and retrieved a scroll that seemed to be sparkling as the minimal light in the alley hit it.
target: Intra vestimenta sordida se inseruerunt et volutum, quod minutissimum lumen in vicula incidens micare videbatur, extraxerunt.

source: They held it out for a second, then threw it towards Sam.
target: Illud per momentum extulerunt, deinde in Sam coniecerunt.

source: Unfortunately, he caught it on reflex.
target: Infeliciter, reflexu id apprehendit.

source: Sam froze, a thousand ideas running through his head as he held the still-sparkling scroll in his hand.
target: Sam immobilis factus est, mille cogitationes per caput eius fluentes, dum volutum adhuc micantem in manu tenebat.

source: He looked at the scroll, then back at the urchin who was smirking at him, and Sam knew it was a payback for his earlier actions.
target: Ille volutum intuens, deinde ad urchinum respiciens, qui eum subridens spectabat, intellexit id esse retributionem pro praeviis factis suis.

source: ‘They are a Fey after all…’
target: "Postremo, illi sunt Fey…"

source: “What is this?” he asked, lowering his hand, holding the scroll as far as possible with all the delicacy of a man holding something horrible.
target: "Quid hoc est?" inquit, manum deponens, volutum tenens quantum poterat cum omni subtilitate hominis rem horribile tenentis.

source: “Reward for a task well done,” came the quick answer.
target: "Praemium pro opere bene facto," celeriter inquit.

source: “And what will it cost me?” he asked, already dreading the answer.
target: "Et quid mihi constabit?" inquit, iam metuens responsum.

source: On one hand, he wanted nothing to do with the shenanigans of the Fey, on the other hand, his gamer senses were screaming at him to obtain the probably rare item.
target: Ex una parte nihil cum malis artibus Fey agere volebat; ex altera parte sensus ludicri eius clamabant ut item, probabiliter rarum, obtineret.

source: “Nothing,” spoke the urchin, scowling as if the word caused him physical pain.
target: "Nihil," inquit urchinus, vultu contrito, quasi verbum ipsum dolorem corporalem inferret.

source: “You did us a favor. This is a repayment.”
target: "Nobis beneficium fecisti. Hoc est retributio."

source: Sam wisely decided not to ask what he did because he suspected it would only cause him more headaches.
target: Sapienter Sam decrevit non quaerere quid id significaret, suspiciens id tantum ei ulteriores molestias inferre.

source: Instead, he silently put the scroll away into his inventory.
target: Pro eo silentio volutum in inventarium suum recondidit.

source: As he was about to figure out how to disengage from the conversation, he had a wicked idea.
target: Dum consilium de conversatione evellenda meditaturus erat, maleficam ideam cepit.

source: “Say, are you guys free?”
target: "Dic, estisne liberi?"

source: The moment the question left his mouth, the brat moping in the shadows perked up and began eying him with interest.
target: Eo momento, postquam quaestio eius ex ore abiit, puer in umbris excitatus est et eum cum studio intuens coepit.

source: “It will cost you, mister!”
target: "Constabit tibi, domine!"

source: He retrieved a handful of silver and threw it towards the Fey, who caught all of it with deft movements and vanished them into their clothing.
target: Argenti manum rapuit et in Fey iactavit, qui totum subtilibus motibus ceperunt et in vestimenta sua absconderunt.

source: “I’m listening.”
target: "Audiō."

source: Sam looked around and after not seeing anybody, leaned closer to the young child.
target: Sam circumspiciebat, et postquam neminem animadvertit, propius ad puerum accessit.

source: “I need you to spread a rumor…”
target: "Te rogo ut rumor diffundas…"

source: The Fey stepped closer, and Sam could almost see them vibrating in excitement.
target: Fey propius accessit, et Sam paene eos in excitamento vibrare vidit.

source: “Yeees?”
target: "Ita?"

source: “Make sure that everyone who needs to know knows, that the Greyskull Guild is planning to raid the warehouse of the Auction House.”
target: "Fac ut omnes, qui scire necesse habeant, sciant Greyskull Guild consilium habere horreum Domus Auctionis dirumpere."

source: “Are they?”
target: "Suntne?"

source: “Of course not.”
target: "Minime."

source: Laughter was his only reply.
target: Risus sola responsio eius fuit.

source: Sam watched as the Fey contemplated his words, and then they nodded.
target: Sam intuens erat, dum Fey verba eius contemplabant, et deinde annuerunt.

source: “It will be done.”
target: "Id fiet."

source: “Good.”
target: "Bene."

source: Following an unspoken signal, both of them took a step back, the young street urchin covered in shadows and Sam bathing in the sickly light of the city.
target: Secuti tacitum signum, uterque gradum retro ceperunt, puer vagus umbris operitus, et Sam in lumine aegroto urbis involutus.

source: Suddenly, Sam heard a crow’s caw and instinctively looked up, searching for the source, and after finding nothing, he looked back down and saw the alley was empty.
target: Subito, Sam corvi stridorem audivit et instinctive surrexit, fontem quaerens; postquam nihil invenit, oculos deflexit et animadvertit viculam vacuum esse.

source: Shaking his head, he returned to his journey towards the inn, trying to forget that the previous meeting ever happened.
target: Capite concussus, iter ad hospitium retulit, conatus oblivisci conventum praeteritum.

source: Back at the inn, he was fussed over by the overly energetic and very loud Andrea, currently dressed in a princess dress that somehow made her look regal yet kinky.
target: In hospitio reversus, Andrea, nimis energica atque valde clamosa, eum curabat; induta veste principis, quae eum regalem sed etiam insolitam efficiebat.

source: Sam didn’t really understand, but the fussing felt nice.
target: Sam non plane intellexit, sed cura eius bene sensa videbatur.

source: After eating a decent meal, he begged off a drinking competition with Andrea, which was taken up by a slightly tipsy adventurer with wandering eyes nearby, and retreated to his room.
target: Postquam edulcis cenam consumpsit, certamen bibendi cum Andrea recusavit, quod a paulo ebrioso adventore cum vagantibus oculis prope suscipiebatur, et se in conclave suo recepit.

source: Chucking off the armor, and changing into more comfortable clothing, he spent a little time organizing his inventory, placing the Grimoire and still obnoxiously sparkling scroll on the table.
target: Arma deponens et in vestimenta commodiiora se induens, parum temporis consumpsit ad suum inventarium ordinandum, posuens Grimoriem et volutum adhuc nimis micantem in mensa.

source: Then he spent a relaxing half an hour feeding and playing with Lucky.
target: Deinde dimidium horae relaxante tempore consumpsit, Lucky alens et ludens cum eo.

source: Running his hand through Lucky’s incredibly soft fur while sitting on the bed, his back to the wall, he took the Grimoire into his hand and channeled a little magic into it.
target: Manum per pilos Lucky incredibiliter molles transcurrens, sedens in lecto cum tergo ad parietem, Grimoriem in manum tulit et paululum magiam in illud infudit.

source: Immediately, it began to shine, and the wind picked up in the room, swirling around him for a few seconds until the book shattered into motes of magic which joined the wind swirling and after a few seconds of theatrics surged into his chest.
target: Statim, incipuit fulgere, et ventus in conclave surrexit, eum per paucas secundas circumvolvens, donec liber in particulas magicae confractus est, quae cum vento circumvolante coniunctae sunt, et post paucas secundas theatricae effusionis in pectus eius irruperunt.

source: He just stared at the notification screen, wanting to know how many spells he would gain.
target: Sam spectabat tabulam nuntiationis, quaerens scire quot incantationes adipiscetur.

source: Sam hoped that Lucky’s Lucky Aura would kick in…
target: Sam sperabat ut aura fortunata Lucky inchoaret…

source: The game didn’t make him wait too long as the wind died down and the light show was finished and the notification screen appeared.
target: Ludus non diu eum exspectare fecit, cum ventus cessavit et spectaculum lucis confectum esset, et tabula nuntiationis apparuit.

source: [Congratulations, you read the Grimoire of Sharp Winds. Several new spells have been inscribed into your own Grimoire!]
target: [Gratulatio, Grimoriem Ventorum Acuorum legisti. Plura nova incantationes in tuo Grimori inscriptae sunt!]

source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Bullet!]
target: [Incantationem "Telum Ventorum" didicisti!]

source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Bullet Barrage!]
target: [Incantationem "Tumultus Telerum Ventorum" didicisti!]

source: [You have learned the spell, Healing Wind!]
target: [Incantationem "Ventus Sanans" didicisti!]

source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Jump!]
target: [Incantationem "Saltus Ventorum" didicisti!]

source: [You have learned the spell, Wind Edge!]
target: [Incantationem "Acies Ventorum" didicisti!]

source: [Wind Bullet: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to launch a bullet made of concentrated wind!]
target: [Telum Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio simplex quae tibi sinit telum ex vento concentrato iaculari!]

source: [Wind Bullet Barrage: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to release a barrage of wind bullets at your target. The damage of the released Wind Bullets depends on the Wind Bullet spell and your mastery over it.]
target: [Tumultus Telerum Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio quae tibi sinit multitudinem telerum ventorum in metam tuam iaculari. Damnum telerum ventorum emissorum pendet ex incantatione "Telum Ventorum" et tuae peritiae super eam.]

source: [Healing Wind: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to release a small gust of refreshing wind that restores a very small amount of stamina and health for the target.]
target: [Ventus Sanans: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio quae tibi sinit parvum flatus venti refrigerii dimitteri, qui parvam quantitatem staminae et valetudinis destinatae restituat.]

source: [Wind Jump: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A simple spell that allows you to launch yourself upwards (or forward) with a small application of wind.]
target: [Saltus Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio simplex quae tibi sinit te ipsum sursum (aut in ante) propellere cum parva applicatione venti.]

source: [Wind Edge: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to enhance the edge of any bladed weapon you wield with the wind. The blade's cutting power will increase as well its reach.]
target: [Acies Ventorum: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activum) Incantatio quae tibi sinit aciem cuiuslibet arma cultrata, cum auxilio venti, augere. Potentia caedendi eius et amplitudo augebitur.]

source: Sam stared for a long moment, but before he could celebrate, another screen showed up in front of him.
target: Sam diu intuitus est, sed antequam celebrare potuit, alia tabula in conspectu eius apparuit.

source: [Due to your mastery of mana, and the fact that you mastered one Wind type spell, after learning more than seven Wind spells, you have gained the skill, Wind Affinity!]
target: [Propter dominatum tuam manae et propter id quod unam incantationem venti generis peritatus es, postquam plus quam septem incantationes venti didicisti, adeptus es artem: Affinitas Ventorum!]

source: [Wind Affinity: Level 0/100 (0%) (Passive) You have a good affinity for the wind. Beings born of the wind will be more favorable to you. The cost of the Wind-type spells and skills is reduced and their power is increased by 0,5% for each skill level.]
target: [Affinitas Ventorum: Gradus 0/100 (0%) (Passivum) Bona affinitas ad ventum tibi competit. Entia ex vento oriunda tibi magis favorabiles erunt. Sumptus incantationum et artium generis venti minuantur, et potentia earum augetur 0,5% pro quolibet gradu artis.]

source: That wasn’t as surprising, but it was still good news.
target: Non tam mirum erat, sed tamen bona nuntia erant.

source: Sam smiled, then went over his new skills, trying to figure out where he would or could use them.
target: Sam subridens deinde novas artes suas examinavit, quaerens ubi eas uti vel adhibere posset.

source: When he started building his skill set, he wasn’t really aiming for wind-type skills, but he couldn’t complain.
target: Cum artem suam instruere coepit, non vere ad artes venti intendebat, sed queri non potuit.

source: It wasn’t the ‘strongest’ element, but, for example, it was the easiest to get a flying spell in this element.
target: Non erat elementum "fortissimum", sed, exempli gratia, facillimum erat incantationem volandi in hoc elemento adipisci.

source: If Sam wanted truly strong spells, without specializing in the element, he would need to delve into the sub-elements.
target: Si Sam incantationes vere validas optaret, sine specialiter in elemento se dedicando, necesse esset in sub-elementa penetrare.

source: Like the Shadows.
target: Sicut umbrae.

source: Shaking his head, he dismissed the screen and reluctantly reached for the scroll that managed to drench the table in glitter.
target: Capite concussus, tabulam nuntiationis abiecit et, invitus, volutum quod mensam in nitore replebat, arripuit.

source: ‘Fricking Fey…’
target: "Maledicti Fey…"

source: Knowing that not opening it would more than likely anger the Fey, he unfurled the scroll with a harsh motion.
target: Sciens quod, si non aperiret, verisimiliter Fey irari posset, volutum cum motu asperso evolvit.

source: [Congratulations, the Fey deemed you worthy of their reward due to your action. We are very sorry!]
target: [Gratulatio, Fey te dignum praemium suum iudicaverunt propter actum tuum. Valde dolemus!]

source: [You gained the skill, Shadow Mirage!]
target: [Artem "Phantasma Umbrarum" adeptus es!]

source: [Shadow Mirage: Level 0/50 (Active) By making use of the Shadows, you are able to create a mirage of yourself near your real body. This mirage will not move, set in the pose as you were at its creation. Leveling up the skill this can be changed, as the mirage learns from its creator. Numbers of Mirages that can be currently created: 1.]
target: [Phantasma Umbrarum: Gradus 0/50 (Activum) Incantatio per qua, utendo umbris, phantasmam tui iuxta corpus verum creare potes. Haec phantasma non movebitur, statu in quo creata fuit servato. Per augenda artem hoc mutari potest, quoniam phantasma ab eius creatore discit. Numerus phantasmatum qui nunc creare possunt: 1.]

source: “Well, this is singularly incredibly awesome, and mostly useless without leveling up…” he murmured, a little in awe.
target: "Heu, hoc est singulariter incredibile, et plerumque inutile, nisi gradus augeas..." murmurat, paulo in admiratione.

source: He knew this skill. In the future that never will be, one of the most famous assassins used this skill to perform countless assassinations on many prominent players, then leaving the scene while people were fighting his mirages.
target: Sciebat hanc artem. In futuro, quod numquam fiet, unus ex clarissimis sicariis hanc artem utebatur ad innumerabiles caedes in pluribus claris lusoribus perficiendas, deinde scenam relinquens dum homines phantasmata eius pugnabant.

source: Dismissing the screen, he threw a disgusted look at the glitter that didn’t vanish when he learned the spell in the scroll and decided it was tomorrow’s Sam’s problem.
target: Dimittens tabulam nuntiationis, aspiciens vultum indignum ad nitorem, qui non evanuit cum incantationem in voluto didiceret, et decrevit id esse problema crastini Sami.

source: Snuggling up to Lucky, he closed his eyes and logged out.
target: Conglutinans Lucky, oculos clausit et sessionem finivit.
